'''''Star Wars Insider''''' is Lucasfilm's official magazine. Issue 43 (April/May 1999) printed [[Ryan Morris]]'s [[The Thrill of Victory (Star Wars Insider)|The Thrill of Victory]] on the [[1998 Decipher World Championship]].<ref name="wook-43" /><ref name="insider-1998" /> [[Richard Handley|Rich Handley]] covered the next two in [[All Decked Out (Star Wars Insider)|All Decked Out]] (#48) and [[Deal With It! (Star Wars Insider)|Deal With It!]] (#52).<ref name="insider-48" /><ref name="insider-52" />

[[File:Star Wars Insider 43 page 64.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Star Wars Insider #43, page 64.]]
[[File:Star Wars Insider 43 page 65.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Star Wars Insider #43, page 65.]]

Decipher also ran display ads in the magazine.<ref name="enc165" /> The dated catalog is [[Magazines]].
